label: The fixed contingent-predecessor interpretation retains selected-world…, by Direct-proof
meaning: One fixed endpoint-sound, distinct-cause interpretation retains the named theorem's reflexivity, necessity, potential role and union-WF backgrounds but violates the no-contingent-predecessor bridge and named underivedness. The selected necessary false actually receives a cause from contingent true at false. Only false is necessary, so the necessary-only union is empty despite the local two-cycle. This tests the exact missing bridge; worldwise causal WF, temporal coherence and metaphysical possibility are not claimed. Because its actual world false has a two-cycle, this control is outside the owner's acyclic-world setting; it only tests the weaker background without pointwise WF.
